decisions.rationale: One assessable explanation: compatible vector-host expression signals and functions produce the encoded protein; DNA presence alone is insufficient. EN is equivalent. The new matching image and complete native page support this bounded model without adding a laboratory duty.

Relate developmental genetics to evolutionary processes correctly translates einordnen in this causal context; it is not a classification task. Hox spatial regulation and regulatory timing are treated as sources of developmental variation, with inheritance/selection/speciation separately bounded.

The complete current page is one fossil-to-hypothesis reconstruction competence. Chronology, hypotheses and limits are coherently joined; culture is separately taught by goal802 rather than demanded by this text. The fossil visualization supports competing evidence-sensitive hypotheses.

Read both complete EN/DE cases and the complete profile: fossil-mosaic chronology and habitat/search-bias hypotheses have different material premises and fresh counterevidence. Removing the English culture demand restores DE/EN equivalence. Worked responses do not infer direct ancestry or language from tools; the rubrics count only demonstrated aspects. Synthetic material, no actual experiment and no learner performance are truthful E1/G1 limits.

Whole retained promoter/host and intact-code/processing-limit cases remain correct. DNA, mRNA, translation and functional final product are distinguished. The new raster requires a current resource binding; body preservation is not a new laboratory result.

Whole retained Hox spatial activation and enhancer timing cases distinguish developmental effects, heritability, sterility, plasticity and reproductive success. Current EN relation wording is equivalent to the goal. No unrelated P restart is warranted.

Both plasmids remain visibly present. Recognized promoter signal permits mRNA/ribosome/target-protein chain; the right dashed arrow ends at a red stop and no target protein. Labels are legible at the actual 360 and 680 pixel captures. Contrast, arrows and words carry the comparison without relying on color alone. It is a schematic orientation model, not a real experimental record or proof that every recognized promoter guarantees final functionality.
